CLASSIFICATION::disable
       Deprecated: Disables classification for the current flow.

SYNOPSIS
       CLASSIFICATION::disable

DESCRIPTION
       This command disables classification for the current flow.

       CLASSIFICATION::disable

RETURN VALUE
VALID DURING
EXAMPLES
HINTS
       CLASSIFY::disable replaces this command

SEE ALSO
       CLASSIFY::disable

CHANGE LOG
       @BIGIP-11.5.0 --First introduced the command.  @BIGIP-12.0.0 -- Deprecated in favor of CLASSIFY namespace

BIG-IP							    2022-04-12							  iRule(1)
